note: The intake record is 200 bytes (APP-INPUT-RECORD X(200)) but is read INTO the 130-byte PRVRECRD work area, so bytes 131-200 of each intake record are ignored. The real intake layout is not defined anywhere in the estate.
The master FD declares 121 bytes but PRVRECRD is 130, so PRV-OWNER-NPI (bytes 121-130) would be lost on a 121-byte file (INFERRED effect). D-007: 130 is correct.
A persistent read error (status other than 00 or 10) never sets the end-of-file flag, so the PERFORM UNTIL loop would repeat forever (INFERRED, not executed).
Duplicate detection happens only at WRITE (status 22). EC-DUP-NPI (E103) is never used (D-016).
Only the missing-NPI branch moves an error code (cut to 2 bytes); E102 and E104 are never assigned (D-016).
WS-ERR-DETAIL (X(250)) has no VALUE and STRING does not clear it, so bytes 41-250 of every error row are undefined (INFERRED).
RC 4 at termination overwrites an earlier RC 8, so a hard error is reported to the job as a warning (D-017 area).
Counters are not exclusive: an invalid application is counted as read, as errored and then as written or skipped.
